test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the given letter-cluster triads, the letter-cluster in a particular triad are related following a certain logic. Study the given triads carefully and from the given options, select the triad that follows the same logic,

(ACE : BDF : CEG)

(SUW : TVX : UWY)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

(ACE : BDF : CEG)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c892f3823d2af2b12da23df2ce90e3938e89af70af2407b290fdf62eeee3ba52.png] 

And,

(SUW : TVX : UWY)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/903e75abf05c0cf3dbad0149138f88929ceae5f06069dd3b000216efedb87f3a.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (SUW : TVX : YAC)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c163435efc1af454d5c15f94499345f84b84837b568386121eb7eb640ca0736.png] 

Option 2) (KMO : LNP : MOQ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33e04093ebc5b184d1a9e57bb2f7d85e633086789a764dffa4ef24ed809013f6.png] 

Option 3) (QRS : TUV : WXY)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e72d9259e086cc6e19233c55a2c40130d2ff5850c90487438367f42b42aca9f3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4834870fd9cda71bc3574978b1cd60acdc4265975c91777fbdb0fc604a2cc34c.png] 

Option 4) (ACF : BDE : CFH)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff32386c3a5b18d941b3fe2c3913fe39c8d82e97abec941c917b4faf4ec6b53d.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, '(KMO : LNP : MOQ)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
